non_exam_control.interpretation: KV4/start0 gives0/3 valid exact JSON controls. KVNone gives2/3 exact JSON; arithmetic contains correct result5 inside Markdown fences and must NOT be reported as strict3/3. These same-process controls strongly implicate enabling the quantized KV condition; they do not establish a specific Metal kernel defect or general mathematical invalidity of all quantized KV implementations.
non_exam_control.ordering_limitation: All KV4 controls ran before KVNone, not a randomized cross-over; no long-context comparison or tensor-level logit oracle was performed in this audit.

important_source_level_findings.supported_not_validated: The Qwen3 architecture has a legal QuantizedKVCache path with head_dim128/group64. Argument acceptance and compatible layout establish code-path support, not numerical fidelity, robust text generation or parity on this model/device/settings.
important_source_level_findings.dispatch_difference: KVCache uses mx.fast.scaled_dot_product_attention. A cache with bits selects a separate quantized attention implementation with quantized_matmul and explicit score/softmax computation in models/base.py. Enabling KV4 changes precision and arithmetic/kernel paths.
important_source_level_findings.conversion_timing: generate_step processes N-1 prompt tokens in prefill, calls maybe_quantize_kv_cache after the block, then handles the final prompt token through the quantized cache when start0. A49–64-token prompt at prefill128 can therefore fail without any multi-chunk quantized prefill.
important_source_level_findings.masked_prefill_claim: The short non-exam controls all fit below128. A bug requiring multiple quantized prefill chunks or a multi-query causal mask is not necessary to reproduce this failure; do not label masked prefill the confirmed cause.
important_source_level_findings.memory_limits: The KVNone controls keep prefill128, cache32MiB and allocator limit2.75GiB fixed and recover coherent content. This argues against those limits alone as sufficient explanation, but no full factorial or tensor-level test was performed.
important_source_level_findings.weight_template_identity: Model fingerprint/weight SHA and historical template identity were already checked by root; metadata above agrees across arms. Reviewer did not re-read the1GB weights. No evidence here calls for changing weights/template/prompts.

primary_upstream_checks.topic: Quantized KV packed storage width fix
primary_upstream_checks.status_at_review: Open PR, not an installed fix
primary_upstream_checks.relevance: The changed formulas dim//(32//bits) versus dim*bits//32 differ for some non-divisor precisions. For our bits4 and dim128 both give16 packed uint32 values; this PR does not establish the cause of our4-bit failure. No patch applied.
Runtime uses max_kv_size=None and ordinary full KVCache before quantization, not RotatingKVCache. A rotating eviction/sink mask bug cannot simply be transferred to this case.
Explains why entry points/defaults matter; our start0 is explicit, not an unnoticed default. It does not document this exact local corruption.

primary_upstream_checks.relevance: Different hardware, model, core version and unquantized SDPA path; our short controls fail below64 tokens. Not evidence of this specific bug.
MoE128-expert routing/gather_mm report, unlike dense Qwen3-1.7B. Same-chip symptom alone is insufficient attribution.

search_conclusion: Targeted upstream primary-source search found related cache/kernel issues, but no confirmed report matching dense Qwen3-1.7B4-bit + mlx0.32.4 + mlx-lm0.32.2 + KV4/group64/start0 + short prompt corruption. Absence from this search is not proof no such issue exists.

gate_defect_and_fix.observed: Old --probe measured resources and exit0 only. Its stored raw was repeated capacity tokens, but main gate never checked a successful expected JSON answer. A capacity/resource pass is not a functional-sanity pass.
gate_defect_and_fix.prompt_design_note: The probe placed instruction before a long repeated capacity filler. Such a prompt can itself dilute instructions; repeated filler alone did not prove the KV defect. Independent short controls provide the stronger isolation.
required_new_gate: Keep resource guard pressure/swap thresholds unchanged.
Use non-exam padded prompt with final clear instruction after filler; validate a predeclared expected JSON and reject malformed/incorrect output before evaluated questions.
Also check bounded simple JSON/arithmetic and invented-source retrieval controls; distinguish semantic arithmetic in a fence from exact JSON success.
Store both resource status and functional control results; either failing blocks evaluation.

recommended_prospective_recovery.mode: Disable KV quantization uniformly (kv_bits=None) for all3 arms if root accepts the sanity evidence; preserve same model/template/frozen questions/source/retrieval and prefill128/cache limits.
recommended_prospective_recovery.protocol: Preserve old freeze/raw/resources under invalid-kv4-attempt classification, write a new attempt/freeze and explain the infrastructure change openly. No answer repair or cherry-picking from old attempt; redo every main arm under the new uniform condition.
recommended_prospective_recovery.resource_recheck: Unquantized KV adds estimated~0.14GiB persistent KV near this budget, but measured new padded probe is required; no guarantee from the estimate. Keep3.5GiB footprint/.25GiB swap growth/pressure2×3 protection.
recommended_prospective_recovery.scope: Do not install an upstream patch or change model precision/version mid-comparison merely because a related PR exists. A future exact root-cause report would need controlled tensor/logit tests beyond this read-only audit.
